caption:
The math nobody says out loud. 🧮

$500 sitting on a card at 22% APR is roughly $110 a year in interest.

Pay it off in full each month: about $0 in interest.

Same purchase. Very different cost.

How quickly do you usually pay off your card?
first_comment: Full balance, or just the minimum? Be honest 👇
